html:
{#-
  Swap Tag — 4" × 2" prints landscape (1200 × 600 dots @ 300 DPI),
  but designed to be VIEWED in portrait (tilt label 90° CCW so the
  Brand row sits at the top and the barcode at the bottom — like the
  original yellow Barrie's hang tag).
  ---------------------------------------------------------------
  All text uses ^A0B (270° rotation) and barcode uses ^BCB so they
  read correctly in portrait orientation.

  Portrait layout (600 wide × 1200 tall, top → bottom):
    Brand   / value
    Model   / value
    Size    / value
    Color   / value
    ─────────────────
    Swap Price
    $XXX.XX  (large)
    MSRP
    $XXX.XX  (strikethrough)
    ─────────────────
    [Code 128 barcode]
    item_code (single line, no duplicate)

  Coordinate conversion: portrait (px, py) → landscape FO (py, 600-px).

  Fields pulled:
    doc.brand              → Brand value
    doc.custom_model       → Model value
    doc.custom_size        → Size value
    doc.custom_color       → Color value
    doc.custom_swap_price  → big featured price
    doc.standard_rate      → MSRP crossed out
    doc.custom_upc_helper / doc.item_code → barcode
-#}
^XA
^MNY
^LL600
^PW1200
^CI28

^FO30,570^A0B,22,22^FDBrand:^FS
^FO65,570^A0B,36,36^FB540,1,0,L,0^FD{{ (doc.brand or "")[:22] }}^FS

^FO140,570^A0B,22,22^FDModel:^FS
^FO175,570^A0B,36,36^FB540,1,0,L,0^FD{{ (doc.custom_model or "")[:22] }}^FS

^FO250,570^A0B,22,22^FDSize:^FS
^FO285,570^A0B,36,36^FB540,1,0,L,0^FD{{ (doc.custom_size or "")[:22] }}^FS

^FO360,570^A0B,22,22^FDColor:^FS
^FO395,570^A0B,36,36^FB540,1,0,L,0^FD{{ (doc.custom_color or "")[:22] }}^FS

^FO460,20^GB0,560,3^FS

^FO480,580^A0B,28,28^FB560,1,0,C,0^FDSwap Price^FS
^FO530,580^A0B,80,80^FB560,1,0,C,0^FD${{ "{:.2f}".format(doc.custom_swap_price or 0) }}^FS

^FO660,580^A0B,24,24^FB560,1,0,C,0^FDMSRP^FS
^FO700,580^A0B,40,40^FB560,1,0,C,0^FD${{ "{:.2f}".format(doc.standard_rate or 0) }}^FS
^FO720,140^GB0,320,3^FS

^FO780,20^GB0,560,3^FS

{%- set barcode_data = doc.custom_upc_helper or doc.item_code -%}
{% if barcode_data %}
^BY2,2,200
^FO820,520^BCB,200,N,N,N,A^FD{{ barcode_data }}^FS
{% endif %}

^FO1060,580^A0B,30,30^FB560,1,0,C,0^FD{{ doc.item_code or "" }}^FS

^XZ
